summary: 5 errors, 33 minor. Errors: unit 42 preverb ā attached to tvā instead of mahyā; 45 huvema root √hū; 49 kakubham case; 59 patyete root and agan number. Grouping: agree that prohyamāṇaḥ (56) belongs to the end of 55 and sannaḥ (59) to the end of 58 (name+participle pattern); edition division can stay. Confidence values are honest; no unit needs raising. Glossary fixes applied: karma=rite (45), śukra=उज्ज्वल (49, 57). Suggested glossary additions: bhuvana (भुवन) distinct from loka; rajas = airy realm (अन्तरिक्ष के क्षेत्र); somakrayaṇī, abhigara kept transliterated.
